title: "MUDAB Pilot Database"

This site presents the initial version of the database design and its potential applications using the publicly available [MUDAB](https://www.mudab.de/en) dataset.

{{< include _generations.qmd >}}

## Source Data

-  [Marine Environmental Database (MUDAB)](https://www.mudab.de/en)

### Count of Sediment Sites
The table below summarizes the number of sediment sites collected across three organization between 1984 and 2024.

{{< include _db-setup.qmd >}}

```{ojs}
//| output: false

aq = require("arquero")

// --- Query: long format counts per cruise type, year, and element ---
counts_long = db.query(`
    SELECT organisation,
           year,
           parameter_name,
           COUNT(*) AS count
    FROM (
          SELECT DISTINCT
            COALESCE(s2.organisation, 'Unknown') AS organisation,
            CAST(CAST(m.year AS INTEGER) AS TEXT) AS year,
            s1.station_no,
            s1.survey_id,
            s1.measurement_time_id,
            s1.analysis_method_id,
            s1.sample_no,
            s1.lod_id,
            s1.sediment_no,
            s1.parameter,
            UPPER(SUBSTR(p.parameter_name, 1, 1)) || LOWER(SUBSTR(p.parameter_name, 2)) AS parameter_name
          FROM sediment s1
          JOIN station s2 ON s2.station_no = s1.station_no
          JOIN measurement_time m ON m.measurement_time_id  = s1.measurement_time_id
          JOIN parameter p ON p.parameter  = s1.parameter
          WHERE s1.parameter IN ('CO', 'CU', 'MN', 'MO', 'SE', 'ZN')
            AND s1.measured_value IS NOT NULL
    ) t
    GROUP BY organisation, year, parameter_name
`)

// --- Pivot to wide format using Arquero ---
elements_wide = ["Cobalt", "Copper", "Manganese", "Molybdenum", "Selenium", "Zinc"]

counts_wide = aq.from(counts_long)
  .groupby("organisation", "year")
  .pivot("parameter_name", "count")
  .orderby("organisation", "year")
  .rename({ organisation: "Organisation", year: "Year" })
  .objects()
```

```{ojs}
Inputs.table(counts_wide, {
  columns: ["Organisation", "Year", ...elements_wide],
  layout: "auto",
  rows: 20
})
```

## Database Design and Creation

After creating the ER (Entity–Relationship) diagram, the tables were implemented in a single SQLite file containing 10 tables. All required data were extracted from the MUDAB export file and imported into the corresponding tables.

- See the [DB Schema (Full)](./db-schema.qmd) page for details of the full database architecture.
- See the [Data Preparation](./data-preparation.qmd) page for the data preparation process used prior to importing the MUDAB dataset.
- See the [Database Downloads](./database-downloads.qmd) page for the download link to the SQLite database file.

## Geospatial Analysis

The pilot database reserves columns for the distance to the nearest coastline, the
nearest country and municipality, and the sea or ocean name, but leaves them empty.

They were derived here until August 2026, and the three pages that presented them
have been retired along with the calculation. The reason is that they never reached
any later stage: the clean generation recomputes all of them from the site
coordinates and overwrites whatever the pilot held, so deriving them twice produced
a second set of numbers that could only disagree with the ones that survive. The
values now live on the [multised-clean](https://seafood-hazards.github.io/multised-clean/)
site.
